verdict.rationale: Clara documents a first-party Clara MCP built for AI assistants to inspect or act on Clara data in natural language, such as listing cards, reviewing transactions and switching companies. Its agent-instructions page adds guardrails for money-moving actions like Pix payments, and the marketing site describes an AI 'CFO agent', so the core of natural-language operation is delivered. missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface (the documented path goes through an external AI assistant), detailed MCP tool coverage and setup docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
